champion.tips: JANNA TIPS AND TRICKS Your mindset throughout the game should be to keep your ADC alive at all costs. Stick to them like glue and use everything you can to keep them alive. If needed, cast your Ultimate to knock back would-be engagers to stop them from getting on you or your ADC. Never leave your team's side and don’t wander too far away from them at any given time. Janna is needed to protect her teammates and not being with them is a big no-no. If this means that you can’t ward an objective or have to delay a ward, then you’ll have to do so as the enemy may ambush you as you go to ward alone. Use your W and basic attacks to harass the enemy as much as possible in lane. A good method of poking is by waiting for the enemy to waste an ability and then walk up to them, auto-attack once and then use your W .
champion.builds: THE BEST JANNA BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR SUPPORT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Janna Support build, you should take Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Summon Aery as your keystone, followed by Manaflow Band, Celerity and Gathering Storm in the primary tree, as well as Font of Life and Revitalize in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Move Speed in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Dream Maker as your first item, followed by Boots of Swiftness and Moonstone Renewer. For your last 3 items, you should build Redemption, Dawncore and finish with Vigilant Wardstone. For the skill order, you want to stick with W - E - Q. Right now, this build has 52.7% winrate over 19 591 matches played. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Arcane Comet as your keystone, Manaflow Band, Celerity and Scorch in the primary tree, and Relentless Hunter with Taste of Blood in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Zaz'Zak's Realmspike as your first item, then Boots of Swiftness as a second item and Imperial Mandate as a third item. You want to finish the build with Shurelya's Battlesong, Redemption and Vigilant Wardstone. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it W - E - Q. This build is currently sitting at a 53.8% win rate across 1 250 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Janna Support build in the current patch, try Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells, Summon Aery, Manaflow Band, Celerity and Gathering Storm as your primary rune tree, and Font of Life with Revitalize as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Move Speed and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Solstice Sleigh as your first item, then finish Boots of Swiftness as your second item, and Moonstone Renewer as third item. The last 3 options are Redemption, Dawncore and Vigilant Wardstone. The ability order for this build is E - W - Q. As of the current patch, this build has a 53.6% win rate over 853 matches played. Situational Janna Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Janna build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Janna runes page.
